Fetch target-group occurrence records from GBIF for the survey-intensity term

Source: R/fn_download.R
gbif_records.Rd

Pulls occurrences inside a bounding box from GBIF as sf points, ready to feed survey_surface as the target-group records for S. The pull uses GBIF's server-side bulk download (rgbif::occ_download) - one prepared job rather than thousands of fragile paged requests, and the route GBIF asks heavy users to take. count_only = TRUE first (no account needed) to see the filtered total before committing.

Usage

gbif_records(
  bbox,
  taxon_key = 7707728,
  basis = c("PRESERVED_SPECIMEN", "HUMAN_OBSERVATION"),
  year_from = 1990,
  coord_uncertainty_max = NA,
  crs = NULL,
  count_only = FALSE,
  path = NULL,
  download_dir = NULL,
  user = Sys.getenv("GBIF_USER"),
  pwd = Sys.getenv("GBIF_PWD"),
  email = Sys.getenv("GBIF_EMAIL"),
  poll = 30
)

Arguments

bbox

the area: an sf/terra object (extent used), or numeric c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in lon/lat.

taxon_key

GBIF backbone key to restrict to (default 7707728, Tracheophyta / vascular plants).

basis

basisOfRecord values to keep (default preserved specimens + human observations).

year_from

earliest year to keep (default 1990); NA disables.

coord_uncertainty_max

max coordinate uncertainty in metres (default NA = off, since the field is rarely populated); a number also drops records lacking the field.

crs

output CRS (default lon/lat).

count_only

if TRUE, return just the filtered record count - a cheap request, no account, no download.

path

GeoPackage to write the records to (NULL -> gbif_records.gpkg in the working directory).

download_dir

where to save the GBIF download zip (NULL -> beside path); kept so the costly job need not be re-run.

user, pwd, email

GBIF credentials (default the GBIF_USER/GBIF_PWD/ GBIF_EMAIL environment variables).

poll

seconds between status checks while the download is prepared (default 30).

Value

with count_only, an integer. Otherwise an sf of POINTs with speciesKey, species, basisOfRecord, coordinateUncertaintyInMeters and year; attributes path (file written) and doi (citable download). Pass its coords + speciesKey to survey_surface.

Details

Requires a free GBIF account for the download (not for the count). Register at https://www.gbif.org/, then set GBIF_USER, GBIF_PWD and GBIF_EMAIL (e.g. in ~/.Renviron) or pass them as arguments. A download is minted under your account and citable by its DOI.

Filtering is the point. A raw vascular-plant pull is swamped by imprecise iNaturalist observations. year_from and coord_uncertainty_max trim to records fit to mark where a careful collection happened. The uncertainty filter also drops records with no uncertainty recorded, which is most of them - so it defaults to NA (off); set e.g. 100 only if you want to keep solely well-located records.
